summary: Publish and locally enforce ChatGPT action ID and idempotency key constraints

replay.detail: Adapter argument admission changes no stored projections, claim namespaces, or replay behavior.

schema.detail: Both ChatGPT write-tool input schemas require action IDs starting with action/ and idempotency keys matching ^[ -~]{16,256}$. Fence snapshot descriptions identify the immediately preceding read result. Database schemas and daemon contracts are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, fleet projection digest, or daemon admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The adapter rejects invalid action prefixes and keys outside 16-256 printable ASCII characters before contacting the daemon. ASCII-only keys are deliberately stricter than daemon UTF-8 byte-length admission; previously accepted non-ASCII or control-character keys are no longer accepted by the adapter. Valid ASCII arguments and daemon wire payloads are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No new daemon restart requirement or service interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: Callers must use an action/ prefix and a 16-256 printable ASCII character idempotency key. Reuse the exact action ID and key when retrying the same intended action, and obtain the fence snapshot ID from the immediately preceding read result.

recovery.detail: No state migration or repair is needed. Invalid arguments fail locally with the violated rule named and without submitting an action to the daemon.
